correctness.rationale: Equilibrium renewal age density P(T>a)da/mu, unitary XX evolution starting |00>, and Wootters concurrence of the ensemble X-state give C=E[1−cos(Omega T)]/(Omega mu). Let X=Omega T>0 with mean m. The least concave majorant of f(x)=1−cos x is c*x up to unique xi solving tan(xi/2)=xi, then f(x) on [xi,pi], then constant 2. Jensen proves sharp plateau c*=0.724611..., middle deterministic value f(m)/m, and 2/m tail; strict contact geometry gives exact optimizer support and unattainment below xi. Zero endpoint iff m>=2pi supported on strictly positive full periods. Finite density and moment hypotheses suffice even for lattice clocks, but synchronized time convergence is not claimed. Independent numerical xi/support examples and analytic concurrence derivation checked.
